project.name: Payments
project.description: Payments platform work: charges, refunds, settlement, deploy safety. Demo project for Doc Drift Sentinel.

issues.description: Replace the v1 charges endpoint with POST /v2/charges and GET /v2/charges/:id. Integer minor-unit amounts, idempotency keys, async settlement.
Reject charge requests without an Idempotency-Key of at least 8 characters (400 idempotency_key_required). Store key, body hash and response for 24 hours.
pages: ADR-012: Idempotency keys for charge creation

issues.summary: Return 409 when an idempotency key is reused with a different body
issues.description: Compare the stored request hash. On mismatch return 409 idempotency_key_conflict and log a warning with the key.
pages: ADR-012: Idempotency keys for charge creation

issues.description: Move PSP capture out of the request path into a worker that claims settlement_jobs rows with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.

issues.summary: Move settlement to settlement_jobs with SKIP LOCKED workers
issues.description: Insert a settlement_jobs row with each charge. New payments-workers deployment runs PAYMENTS_ROLE=worker and claims batches of SETTLEMENT_BATCH_SIZE.
Make a bad payments release cheap to undo: a reliable rollback script, clear timeouts, a deploy freeze label, and a rehearsed runbook.

issues.summary: Rename rollback script to rollback-v2.sh and take the timeout in seconds
issues.description: scripts/rollback.sh becomes scripts/rollback-v2.sh. ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT becomes ROLLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECS so the unit is explicit. This is the change in demo PR #482 (scenario 01).
A failed rollback leaves new resources behind. Pass --cleanup-on-fail so a retry starts clean.
Every payments secret lives in Vault, rotates on a schedule, and can be rotated in under 15 minutes during an incident.

issues.summary: Rotate PSP and webhook secrets every 90 days
issues.description: Calendar reminder plus scripts/rotate-secrets.sh. Record each rotation in the secrets register.
Survive the loss of the payments-pg primary with no lost charges and under 5 minutes of errors.
Partial refunds with idempotency keys on POST /v2/refunds, then retire POST /v1/refunds.
pages: ADR-009: Retire the v1 refunds API

issues.summary: Put PgBouncer in front of the payments database
issues.description: Transaction pooling so a failover does not cause a reconnect storm. Lets us lower PAYMENTS_DB_POOL per pod.
Allow several refunds per charge while the sum stays at or below the captured amount (422 amount_exceeds_refundable).
Delete src/routes/refunds-v1.ts and the REFUNDS_V1_ENABLED flag after the 2026-12-15 sunset. Implements ADR-009.
pages: ADR-009: Retire the v1 refunds API

issues.summary: Hold settlement submissions while the PSP is degraded
issues.description: When PSP error rate passes 20% for 2 minutes, stop claiming settlement jobs and back off, instead of retrying into the outage.

issues.summary: Autoscale workers on settlement queue depth
issues.description: Drive the payments-workers HPA from pending settlement_jobs instead of CPU.
Standby payments-pg cluster in a second region with asynchronous replication. RPO 1 minute, RTO 1 hour. Decision: ADR-015.
Provision the standby cluster and stream from the primary region. Measure replication lag at peak.

issues.summary: Replay dead-lettered webhooks from the admin console
issues.description: A button in the admin console for what scripts/replay-webhooks.sh does today, with an audit entry per replay.

wontDo.action: Move to Won't Do (status, or Done with resolution Won't Do)
wontDo.why: Jira rule: status category Done or Won't Do scores 0.7 on the critical PAY-170 anchor. Critical anchors are High.

flips: ADR-009: Retire the v1 refunds API
fixVersionChange.why: Jira rule: fixVersions change scores 0.6 on the critical PAY-158 anchor. The Refunds API guide only mentions PAY-158 (no Jira anchor), so it stays as it is.
